change_contract.goal: Let an operator extend an active session and record that it happened.
acceptance_criteria: Refreshing an active session keeps it usable for a further full window.
Every refresh is recorded so an operator can reconstruct it later.
non_goals: Change how a session is first issued.
preserved_behaviors: An abandoned session still lapses after one window.

operational: Sessions are held in one process and are not shared.
